miners.name: LiveCert — Sourced Answers for Agents
miners.description: Sourced answers for agents and apps across 42 intents, each read live from a named primary source so the caller can check it. Every answer opens with a one-sentence answer, then returns the values as fields, the source and the time it was checked. Compliance: sanctions screening of people, companies and wallets against the OFAC SDN and UN lists with near-match scores; company register records (status, company number, register, registered address and agent, parents) from GLEIF and SEC EDGAR; SEC filings with acceptance times and each 10-Q or 10-K's own XBRL figures; URL reputation from Cloudflare and Quad9 threat DNS, each source named. Research: question answering with every claim cited, web search with dated reports, fact checks with the source URL and evidence sentence, and academic, clinical and news search. Markets: prices and market data for coins, tokens and listed companies, 10-K revenue and earnings, exchange rates and macroeconomic prints (US CPI and unemployment from BLS, the federal funds target range from the New York Fed, euro-area HICP from Eurostat and ECB rates). On-chain: transfer verification with confirmations and the burned base fee, transaction and contract activity across EVM chains, wallet balances, gas, token holders, ERC-20 total supply and burned balance read at a pinned block from two RPCs, any named value read at a stated block height (receipt gas and Transfer amounts, storage slots, balances, block gas), and cross-chain messages. Security: live TLS certificates, URL scans, CVE records, DNS records compared across two resolvers, and fraud signals. Weather: forecasts, current conditions and storm risk. Also translation, IP geolocation, prediction market outcomes, text extraction, sentiment and classification. Chat replies, code reviews and requested writing are generated by a language model (Groq gpt-oss-120b, with two fallbacks), each field checked before it is served and an honest unknown when no model answers; the question-answering, sentiment and classification sentences are phrased by a model with a keyless fallback, and a phrased answer is kept only when every claim cites a numbered source; everything else is computed, not generated.
